extractorOutput: PLAYER: I am still here. / I hold his gaze.
Julian: Say it plainly and I will stop. You do not want me to stop.
(Somewhere behind us a guest shifts, and I remember we are still being watched.)
PLAYER: I am still here. / I hold his gaze.
Julian: Then we understand each other, and everyone here understands us.
(The clearing has not made a sound in a long while.)
PLAYER: I am still here. / I hold his gaze.
Julian: Hold it or set it down. Either tells them something.
(He sets The Answer down on the stone between us and steps back.)
PLAYER: I am still here. / I hold his gaze.
Julian: Then say it where they can hear you, or do not say it at all.
(He waits, and the clearing waits with him.)
